The '''Sector Command''' was in charge of the operations of the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]], replacing the [[Coruscant Security Force Senior Command|Senior Command]], during the early years of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. During that time, the CSF was known as the "Imperial Sector Police".

==Behind the scenes==
The Sector Command first appeared in ''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]'' written by [[Michael Reaves]] and published on [[August 26]], [[2008]].
